 "data": "classDiagram
 direction LR
 namespace AuthAndUsers {
 class UserAccount {
 +string displayName
 +AccountStatus status
 }
 class EngagementPreferences {
 +bool earningEnabled
 +BadgeVisibility visibility
 }
 class GlobalRoleGrant {
 +GlobalRole role
 }
 class EventMembership {
 +EventRole role
 +MembershipStatus status
 }
 class TeamAssignment {
 <<association>>
 }
 }
 namespace Events {
 class Event {
 +string name
 +string organiserName
 +DateRange dates
 +EventStatus status
 }
 class ResponseTeam {
 +ResponseTeamType type
 +string name
 }
 class VenueMapVersion {
 +int version
 +FileReference file
 }
 class PointOfInterest {
 +PoiType type
 +string name
 +MapPosition position
 }
 class Announcement {
 +string message
 +datetime publishedAt
 +datetime expiresAt
 }
 class AttendanceCheckIn {
 +datetime checkedInAt
 }
 }
 namespace Reports {
 class HelpRequest {
 +HelpCategory category
 +MapPosition location
 +Priority priority
 +RequestStatus status
 +datetime submittedAt
 }
 class TriageSuggestion {
 +HelpCategory suggestedCategory
 +Priority suggestedPriority
 +TeamId suggestedTeamId
 +SuggestionDecision decision
 }
 class CommunityReport {
 +ReportType type
 +MapPosition location
 +ReportStatus status
 +datetime expiresAt
 +datetime confirmedAt
 +datetime confirmationRevokedAt
 }
 class FieldTask {
 +FieldTaskPurpose purpose
 +FieldTaskStatus status
 +datetime dispatchedAt
 }
 class AuditEntry {
 +ActorRef actor
 +string action
 +ChangeSet changes
 +datetime occurredAt
 }
 }
 namespace Transports {
 class TransportOption {
 +TransportMode mode
 +DataOrigin origin
 +ExternalRouteReference externalRoute
 +string name
 +datetime lastUpdatedAt
 }
 class TransportDeparture {
 +string destination
 +datetime scheduledAt
 +datetime expectedAt
 }
 class BusVehicle {
 +string externalEntityId
 +string fleetVehicleId
 +string dataProvider
 }
 class BusObservation {
 +GeoPosition location
 +datetime observedAt
 +datetime retrievedAt
 +string routeId
 }
 }
 namespace Badges {
 class BadgeProgress {
 +BadgeTrack track
 +int qualifyingCount
 +BadgeTier tier
 }
 }
 namespace ExternalSystems {
 class PortoDigitalAPI {
 <<external>>
 }
 }
